verdict.rationale: Retell documents one latency tuning lever: a transcription mode that trades accuracy for speed, with an 'optimize for speed' setting using interim results and low endpointing. Latency is also tracked as a metric in the analytics dashboard and scored in AI QA, so engineers can observe it. However, the pack contains no published end-to-end voice latency figures and no broader tuning guide backing speed claims. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end latency numbers or benchmarks, tuning guidance beyond transcription/endpointing (e.g., LLM or TTS choice, turn-taking settings), independent or hands-on latency measurements.
